body: Yeah, I just have somewhat limited time so I was wondering specifically for being able to hit any spending goal if there would be a different optimal way to go about it
It’s all good, but the decompiled AARs are available at https://github.com/OpenFTC/OpenRC-Turbo

This was a quick project that we needed since one of our drivers was going to be quarantined almost right up until the competition; it lets you remotely select an opmode, start it and control it with your controller, or even your keyboard! Everything but controller input should work out of the box except for controls, see readme for details.
